_instructions: Setting descriptors for the configuration composer (see config/configuration/settings-catalog.json). Current values are always read live; descriptors hold no defaults.

settings.description: Text size of chat message bubbles, in pixels.
Mode a new chat starts in: ask (asks before acting), plan (read-only planning) or auto (acts without asking where policy allows).
examples: new chats should start in ask mode

settings.description: Ask for confirmation when someone switches a chat to Auto mode.
examples: warn me before switching to auto
don't ask when I pick auto

settings.description: Largest file, in megabytes, that can be attached to a chat message; null means no limit.
How many files one chat message may attach; null means no limit.
Pause an open chat that nobody is using, so it stops polling the server until someone returns.
examples: keep chats live even when unused

settings.description: How long, in milliseconds, a chat tab in the background stays live before it pauses; 0 never pauses background tabs.
examples: pause background chat tabs after 5 minutes

settings.description: How long, in milliseconds, a visible chat with no taps or typing stays live before it pauses; 0 never pauses visible tabs.
examples: pause an unused chat after 30 minutes
never pause a chat I can see

settings.description: How often, in milliseconds, an open chat checks for new messages.
examples: check for new messages more often

settings.description: Hint text shown in the empty message box.
examples: change the message box hint to 'Ask me anything'
placeholder text should say Type here
the text box should say Ask away

settings.description: Show the Main Notes panel below the chat header in Main Chat.
On phones, how many earlier messages stay loaded above the visible part of a chat.
examples: keep 50 earlier messages on the phone

settings.description: Width, in pixels, of the floating chat widget window.
Which side of the screen the floating chat launcher button sits on.
examples: move the chat button to the left

settings.description: Show the header bar with the title and controls above the conversation.
examples: show the top bar of the chat
remove the header above the messages

settings.description: Widest the chat header may grow, as a CSS length such as 750px.
examples: let the top bar stretch wider

settings.description: Widest the messages may run inside the chat, as a CSS length or percentage such as 1000px; the chat panel itself is sized separately.
examples: narrower lines of text in the conversation

settings.description: What Enter does in the message box: newline adds a line, send sends, auto sends on desktop and adds a line on touch devices.
examples: send the message when I press enter
enter should add a new line
make enter send on desktop only

settings.description: Put the cursor in the message box when a new conversation opens.
examples: focus the message box on new chats
don't jump to the text box in a new conversation
autofocus the composer for new sessions

settings.description: Put the cursor in the message box when an existing conversation opens.
examples: focus the text box when I open an old chat
don't focus the composer on existing conversations

settings.description: Height, in pixels, of the fade at the top of the message list.
examples: less fade at the top of the messages

settings.description: Height, in pixels, of the fade at the bottom of the message list.
examples: no fade above the message box

settings.description: Height, in pixels, of the fade above the message box pill.
examples: smaller fade above the input pill
remove the fade over the composer

settings.description: Height, in pixels, of the fade below the message box pill.
Show the component panel where the agent presents pages and elements.
examples: enable the side panel for agent elements

settings.description: Open the component panel by itself when the agent presents something.
examples: open the panel automatically when the agent shows something
don't pop open the component panel

settings.description: Show the soft glow behind the agent's messages.
examples: turn off the glow on agent messages
no shine behind the assistant bubbles

settings.description: Show the soft glow behind your own messages.
examples: remove the glow from my messages
turn on the shine behind what I type

settings.description: Strength of the glow behind the agent's messages, from 0 (none) to 1 (strongest).
When the action buttons under a message appear: click shows them on tap, engagement on hover or focus, always keeps them visible.
examples: always show the message action buttons
show message buttons only when I click

settings.description: How visible the message action buttons are while idle, from 0 (hidden) to 1 (solid).
examples: make the idle message buttons fainter
action buttons fully visible at rest

settings.description: Size, in pixels, of the small action labels (time, copy, retry) under each message.
Size, in pixels, of the action icons under each message.
Line spacing in the agent's messages, as a multiple of the text size.
examples: more space between lines in replies

settings.description: Line spacing in your own messages, as a multiple of the text size.
examples: more line spacing in my messages
tighter lines in what I send

settings.description: Colour of your message bubbles in light mode, as a CSS colour such as #93c5fd.
examples: make my bubbles green in light mode

settings.description: Colour of your message bubbles in dark mode, as a CSS colour such as #2563eb.
How solid your message bubbles are, from 0 (see-through) to 1 (solid).
Show the action buttons (copy, retry, more) under messages.
examples: show copy and retry under each message

settings.description: Start each message's action buttons hidden until you tap the message.
examples: keep message buttons hidden until I tap

settings.description: Show a name heading above the agent's messages.
examples: show the agent's name above replies
hide the heading on agent messages

settings.description: Name shown in the heading above the agent's messages.
examples: call the agent Ava above its messages

settings.description: Show a name heading above your own messages.
examples: show my name above my messages

settings.description: Name shown in the heading above your own messages.
examples: my messages should be labelled Me

settings.description: Space, in pixels, between one message and the next.
Extra space, in pixels, between one exchange (your message and its reply) and the next.
Greeting the chat shows to someone who has not written yet.
examples: change the greeting to Hello there
greeting should say How can I help?

settings.description: Title shown at the top of the chat.
Small line shown under the chat title.
examples: add a subtitle Usually replies in a minute

settings.description: Text of the first welcome message in a chat.
examples: welcome message should say Hi, I'm Ava

settings.description: Text shown when a new conversation starts.
examples: new session message Ready when you are
change the new chat bubble text
what it says when a conversation starts

settings.description: Manage the phone screen during chat: keep it awake or dim it.
examples: let the phone screen sleep normally
keep the screen awake while chatting

settings.description: Idle time, in milliseconds, before the screen dims during chat; 0 never dims.
examples: dim the screen after a minute

settings.description: How dark the dimmed screen gets, from 0 (no dimming) to 0.95.
Show the agent's tool calls in the activity view.
examples: show what tools the agent uses

settings.description: Group the agent's activity entries together.
Show short previews of the agent's activity.
Also show the agent's activity inside the message list.
examples: keep activity out of the transcript
mirror tool activity in the chat

settings.description: Reopen each conversation where you left off reading.
examples: remember where I was in each chat
always open conversations at the newest message

settings.description: Shorten long messages you sent, with a See more link.
examples: don't cut off my long messages

settings.description: Lines of a long message you sent that show before See more.
After you send a message, scroll so it sits at the top with the reply appearing below it.
examples: stop scrolling my sent message to the top
keep my sent message at the top

settings.description: While you scroll back near your latest sent message, settle gently onto it.
examples: no snapping to my last message

settings.description: Space below the input bar while nothing is typed, as a CSS length such as 24px.
examples: raise the input bar when idle
idle input bar 40px from the bottom

settings.description: Width of the input bar while nothing is typed, as a CSS length such as 500px.
Corner roundness of the input bar while nothing is typed, as a CSS length such as 41px.
examples: square corners on the input bar

settings.description: Space below the input bar while you type, as a CSS length such as 0px.
examples: raise the input bar while typing
input at the very bottom while typing

settings.description: Mark which agent messages are main answers and which are side notes.
Fold everything except main answers in the conversation.
